text:
alisha: Quick heads-up — launching a coordinated SDK + docs policy update today. TL;DR: SDK v4.1 (minor) goes live, docs are reorganized into a compatibility-first layout, and we’re publishing a 90-day sunset calendar for legacy sync clients and old snippet formats. Please read and share.

matt: awesome — what's the exact break? any runtime changes devs should watch for?

alisha: No runtime regressions expected in v4.1. The main user-facing changes:
- param rename: `sync` -> `mode: 'sync'|'async'` (backwards-compatible shim for 90 days)
- snippet output schema tightened (structuredOutput v2) — old snippets will still work but emit a warning in logs
- default retry/backoff improved (no API surface change)

devon: Migration steps? can we have a one-liner? :pray:

alisha: Yep — migration guide is live. Example for python: 
```bash
# pip upgrade and quick replace
pip install -U redwood-sdk
# change usage from: client.generate(sync=True)
# to: client.generate(mode='sync')
```
Full guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/migrate/v4.1 (see "Quick migration")

jane: Are we sunseting the old sync client entirely or just the flag?

alisha: Old sync-only client package (redwood-sync-client) will be deprecated. Timeline:
- 90 days: deprecation notice (today)
- 60 days: install-time deprecation warning added to pip install
- 30 days: doc pages show banner and migration checklist
- 0 days: package removed from new installs but kept for enterprise pinned installs (support case required)

samir: Request from integrators: can we add an automated codemod for the common patterns? I can help write it.

alisha: Yes please — that would be huge. Samir and docs team, please coordinate. We'll link codemod in the migration page and add an example GitHub Action.

docs-bot: docs deploy succeeded — https://docs.redwood.ai (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-23-01) :white_check_mark:

matt: Ops question — will this affect Hosted API customers?

alisha: No breaking changes to server-side API. This is client param/schema cleanup and docs reorg. Hosted API teams: expect no changes, but we will add warnings on server logs for old structured output requests for visibility.

jane: Can we get a short one-paragraph blurb I can paste into customer communications?

alisha: Copy for comms: "We’re releasing SDK v4.1 and a docs reorganization to make migrations and compatibility guidance clearer. A 90-day deprecation applies to legacy sync clients and old snippet schemas; we provide a migration guide, codemod, and extended support for pinned enterprise installs." Feel free to tweak.

matt: Ack. I’ll schedule the external blog and release notes to match the docs deploy window.

samir: I'll start an initial codemod PR and ping here when there's a draft.

alisha: Thanks all. Action items:
- docs: add codemod link and migration checklist (devon + samir)
- eng: keep shim logs for 90 days (matt)
- support: prepare KB snippet and canned response (jane)
We’ll reconvene if any regressions appear. :rocket:
